Audit IPsec Extended Mode allows you to audit events generated by Internet Key Exchange protocol (IKE) and Authenticated Internet Protocol (AuthIP) during Extended Mode
negotiations.
Audit IPsec Extended Mode subcategory is out of scope of this document, because this subcategory is mainly used for IPsec Extended Mode troubleshooting.
